_comment: 英文覆盖层：按索引对齐 foods/scenes/unis 的中文条目（本文件数组顺序必须与 zh 文件一致）。覆盖 desc/history 叙述字段；名称用各条目已有的 en 字段。
history: Wuxi has 3,000 years of history — Taibo came east and began Jiangnan civilization. Turtle Head Isle's cherry blossoms are 'China's first cherry-viewing place'; the Grand Buddha is 88 meters tall. Modern national industry and the Sunan township model started here; today it is a heavy-hitter of the IoT industry.
importance: Pearl of Taihu Lake · Land of fish and rice
foods: Sweet little pork buns, brimming with soup.
Sanfengqiao braised ribs — sweet, salty, fall-apart.
Whitefish, shrimp and silverfish — the lake's finest three.
Gluten puffs stuffed with pork — a homely favorite.
Huishan crispy pastry of the 'diamond navel' kind.
scenes: The finest corner of Taihu — China's No.1 cherry spot.
The 88-meter bronze Buddha and the Brahma Palace.
Ancestral halls and the clay-figure museum.
The ancient canal's 'water lane' at night.
The legend of Fan Li and Xishi among lake rocks.
Rong family's plum garden — early-spring blossoms.
A Jiangnan old street of small bridges.
CCTV film base with live shows.
